name: Covarion.Huelsenbeck02_test
title: Huelsenbeck covarion model with a nonswitching fraction

args.name: pi1
args.description: Fraction of time spent in the ON state

args.name: fraction1
args.description: The fraction of sites undergoing ON/OFF switching

description: Estimates the fraction of sites that follow the Huelsenbeck ON/OFF covarion model. The remaining sites follow the base model without ON/OFF switching, retaining any across-site rate variation in that model.
